0022600195.text: The Trail Blazers (6-2) host the San Antonio Spurs (7-2) in their ninth game of the season, with Portland arriving on a one-game losing streak after a 5-1 road record, while the Spurs are riding a seven-game winning streak. Portland is without Ja Morant (hamstring), Shaedon Sharpe (knee, surgery), and Vit Krejci (ankle), and San Antonio is without Jayden Quaintance (knee, surgery) and Tobias Harris (calf strain). The teams have not met yet in 2026-27; in 2025-26 the Trail Blazers lost 1-2 in the regular season and 1-4 in the playoffs, most recently falling 114-95 in San Antonio on April 28, 2026.
